entities.name: Register a Norwegian rental car for automated tolls
entities.hook: Register the rental with AutoPASS or EPASS24 before passing toll cameras to avoid rental-agency administration fees.

entities.name: Observe average-speed enforcement in Norwegian tunnels
entities.hook: Tunnel cameras can measure point-to-point average speed over miles, with automatic fines for exceeding it.

entities.name: FerryPay
entities.hook: Download before a Norwegian road trip to receive the stated automatic 50% ferry-crossing discount rather than paying onboard.

entities.name: Norway wild-camping and overnight parking restrictions
entities.hook: The Right to Roam does not permit parking a car or camper within 150 metres of an inhabited house; some Lofoten zones ban overnight car parking.

entities.name: Park with the direction of traffic in Norway
entities.hook: Parking facing against traffic is described as illegal even in a marked bay or quiet rural side street and can result in a local fine.

entities.name: Vinmonopolet
entities.hook: For alcohol above 4.7% ABV; the post emphasizes its limited, strict opening hours.

entities.name: Norway alcohol-purchase hours
entities.hook: The post says grocery stores stop selling wine or beer after 6 PM, or 3 PM on Saturdays.
